svg.desc:
From source to chart
1. Write the chart Language: csharp var chart = Chart.Create() .WithTitle("Sign-ins by method") .AddStackedArea("Passkey", passkey) .AddStackedArea("Password", password); chart.SaveSvg("sign-ins.svg");
2. Run it [PowerShell] PS C:\Reports> dotnet run [PowerShell] Wrote sign-ins.svg [PowerShell] PS C:\Reports>
3. Read the result Language: csharp var chart = Chart.Create() .WithTitle("Sign-ins by method") .AddStackedArea("Passkey", passkey) .AddStackedArea("Password", password); chart.SaveSvg("sign-ins.svg"); Sign-ins by method, passkey sign-ins rising
Outcomes: - Sign-ins chart
